_comment: REAL-STUDY HEPPy options: normalised copy of OLD/options_used.json plus explicit seeds, R-peak parameters (legacy defaults, previously implicit), target mains and the pre-specified group-blind QC exclusion rule (v2). Changing any processing key changes every per-recording fingerprint; changing qc_rule only re-evaluates exclusions.

qc_rule.description: Pre-specified, group-blind, outcome-blind; evaluated identically on every recording from QC evidence only (diagnostic labels are never read by the HEPPy stage). Two scopes. RECORDING scope: the whole recording is excluded. SEGMENT scope: only keyfile segments in segment.scope_segments (II and preictal, the segments the registered analysis uses) are evaluated; such a segment is excluded if ANY PyPREP chunk overlapping its time range has a status in pyprep_exclude_statuses or interpolated more than max_interpolated_fraction of its EEG channels. PyPREP chunks that overlap only ictal/postictal/transictal segments never exclude anything. A participant left without a usable II segment is handled downstream (reference minimum), not here.

segment.chunk_overlap: any chunk with positive-length time overlap with the segment
